summary: Add DNS domains to a credential

requestBody.description: The credential and the domains to add to it

dns_credential_id.description: ID of the DNS credential to add the domains to

names.description: Domains such as example.com; a wildcard is not a domain, example.com covers *.example.com

source.description: How the domains were found: typed in (the default) or fetched from the DNS provider

201.description: The domains that were added (a name the credential already had is skipped)

description:
Adds domains to a DNS credential. Each name is stored in lower case ASCII. A name the credential already has is skipped. A name the credential's owner keeps on another credential refuses the whole request, and nothing is stored.

Needs: Certificates manage
